title: Cardmember Spend Allowance on a Finch Circle Card Floor
content:
**Schedule.** For a card floor in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the floor card spend allowance is 20.00 when the Marlowe & Finch purchases charged to the customer's Marlowe & Finch cards in the last 12 whole months, less the Marlowe & Finch merchandise credits posted to them in that time, total 3,000.00 (3000.00) or more, 10.00 when they total 1,500.00 (1500.00) or more but less than 3,000.00, and 0.00 otherwise.

The purchases and merchandise credits are the transactions on every Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account the customer holds, within the last 12 whole months: card purchases at Marlowe & Finch count in, merchandise credits posted to those accounts count out.

| Net Marlowe & Finch card spend in the last 12 whole months (USD) | Floor card spend allowance (USD) |
|---|---|
| 3000.00 or more | 20.00 |
| 1500.00 or more but less than 3000.00 | 10.00 |
| less than 1500.00 | 0.00 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Purchases of 3,400.00 at Marlowe & Finch on the Store Card Elite and the Mastercard together, merchandise credits of 520.00: net 2,880.00, allowance 10.00.
- Purchases of 3,000.00, no credits: net exactly 3,000.00, allowance 20.00.
- Purchases of 1,499.99, no credits: allowance 0.00.
- A purchase at a supermarket on the Mastercard is not a Marlowe & Finch purchase and does not count.
